title: 盾尾空隙同步灌漿
summary: 本課聚焦以環隙體積、漿體時變行為與環片浮力驗證盾尾背填。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on verify tail-void backfill through annular volume, time-dependent grout and lining buoyancy. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「理論環隙與超挖」與「輸送收支與有效填充」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Theoretical annulus and overbreak" and "Delivery balance and effective filling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理論環隙與超挖」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。超挖、地層變形與盾體姿態使實際空隙不同，不能用單一名義體積推定填充已完整。 假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理論環隙與超挖」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield. A circular annular volume is only a reference, since overbreak, ground deformation and shield attitude change the actual space; nominal volume alone does not prove complete filling. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³. Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理論環隙與超挖」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Theoretical annulus and overbreak”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 理論環隙與超挖
knowledge.text: 盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。超挖、地層變形與盾體姿態使實際空隙不同，不能用單一名義體積推定填充已完整。
knowledge.textEn: Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield. A circular annular volume is only a reference, since overbreak, ground deformation and shield attitude change the actual space; nominal volume alone does not prove complete filling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「理論環隙與超挖」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Theoretical annulus and overbreak" is correct?
options: 注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。
盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。
泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。
optionsEn: Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain.
Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield.
The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus.
quiz.explanation: 盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「理論環隙與超挖」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「理論環隙與超挖」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Theoretical annulus and overbreak", which statement holds?
options: 流動度合格就可以不再檢查漿體泌水或材料分離。
計算環片浮力時應使用混凝土材料體積作排開漿體體積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Passing a flow test removes any need to inspect bleeding or segregation.
Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理論環隙與超挖」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄理論環隙與超挖的資料來源與適用條件。核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for theoretical annulus and overbreak. Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
knowledge.textEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄理論環隙與超挖的資料來源與適用條件。核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for theoretical annulus and overbreak. Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill.

quiz.question: 要驗證「理論環隙與超挖」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Theoretical annulus and overbreak"?
options: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
自由試樣收縮百分比必定等於現場環隙的空洞率。
optionsEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Free specimen shrinkage percentage necessarily equals field annular void ratio.
quiz.explanation: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「理論環隙與超挖」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
knowledge.textEn: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「理論環隙與超挖」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Theoretical annulus and overbreak" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space.
The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus.
quiz.explanation: 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Delivery balance and effective filling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輸送收支與有效填充」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delivery balance and effective filling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。每環收支需追蹤時間延遲，否則計量器在本環記錄的材料可能到下一環才排出。 假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輸送收支與有效填充」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there. Ring accounting needs transport delay because volume registered in one ring may arrive during the next. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved. Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delivery balance and effective filling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輸送收支與有效填充」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Delivery balance and effective filling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輸送收支與有效填充
knowledge.text: 泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。每環收支需追蹤時間延遲，否則計量器在本環記錄的材料可能到下一環才排出。
knowledge.textEn: Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there. Ring accounting needs transport delay because volume registered in one ring may arrive during the next.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輸送收支與有效填充」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Delivery balance and effective filling" is correct?
options: 泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。
泵端壓力可以不修正高程與管損直接當環片外壓。
泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。
optionsEn: The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus.
Pump-end pressure directly equals lining pressure without elevation or line-loss correction.
Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there.
quiz.explanation: 泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delivery balance and effective filling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輸送收支與有效填充」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Delivery balance and effective filling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輸送收支與有效填充」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Delivery balance and effective filling", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
平均管線停留短就保證所有死區材料都尚未老化。
最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
A short mean line residence guarantees that material in every dead zone remains fresh.
Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delivery balance and effective filling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輸送收支與有效填充」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Delivery balance and effective filling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄輸送收支與有效填充的資料來源與適用條件。以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for delivery balance and effective filling. Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄輸送收支與有效填充的資料來源與適用條件。以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for delivery balance and effective filling. Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輸送收支與有效填充」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Delivery balance and effective filling"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。
非破壞檢測圖上的每一個反射異常都必定是空洞。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing.
Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void.
quiz.explanation: 以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Delivery balance and effective filling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輸送收支與有效填充」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Delivery balance and effective filling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。
knowledge.textEn: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輸送收支與有效填充」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Delivery balance and effective filling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
泵端壓力可以不修正高程與管損直接當環片外壓。
管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Pump-end pressure directly equals lining pressure without elevation or line-loss correction.
Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery.
quiz.explanation: 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
